title: Keep the Ledger Current from the Business Inbox
summary: Log payments in and bills out from a read-only business mailbox into a running ledger, with a month-end profit draft to check.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you receive payments and bills by email; the value is a current ledger without a month-end rebuild.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: No month-end scramble to rebuild the figures.
Missed payments and bills show up in the ledger sooner.

stack.name: Finance Bot
stack.role: Reads the business mailbox without write access and adds a row for each money movement to a Google Sheets ledger.
stack.creator: johnboyle

stack.name: Small Business Bookkeeper
stack.role: Checks the ledger rows and keeps your books tidy for your accountant.
stack.creator: MarsHomestead

steps.name: Finance Bot
steps.does: Adds a ledger row for each money movement

steps.name: You
steps.does: Checks the month-end draft against the bank

outputs: A running ledger and a month-end draft to review

steps: Pick the business mailbox that receives payments and bills.
Set up the Google Sheets ledger with clear columns.
Check the first month of rows against the bank.
Review the month-end profit draft with your accountant.
guardrails: Check every row against the bank before you rely on it.
This is admin help, not tax or financial advice.
